<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2162040_documate.DocuMateFieldAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DocuMateFieldAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var DocuMateFieldAjax = Class.create();
DocuMateFieldAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getFieldsForTemplate: function() {
        var templateSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_template');

        if (!templateSysId)
            return '[]';

        var template = new GlideRecord('x_2162040_documate_templates');

        if (!template.get(templateSysId))
            return '[]';

        var tableName = template.getValue('source_table');

        if (!tableName)
            return '[]';

        var sourceGr = new GlideRecord(tableName);

        if (!sourceGr.isValid())
            return '[]';

        sourceGr.initialize();

        var result = [];
        var fields = sourceGr.getFields();

        for (var i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
            var field = fields.get(i);

            var fieldName = field.getName();
            var fieldLabel = field.getLabel();

            // Optional: hide system fields
            // if (fieldName.indexOf('sys_') === 0)
            //     continue;

            result.push({
                value: fieldName,
                label: fieldLabel + ' [' + fieldName + ']'
            });
        }

        result.sort(function(a, b) {
            return a.label.toLowerCase() > b.label.toLowerCase() ? 1 : -1;
        });

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    type: 'DocuMateFieldAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-28 02:21:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>399bd9c4c398971076cbbecdd401311c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DocuMateFieldAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="DocuMate" source="x_2162040_documate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="DocuMate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_399bd9c4c398971076cbbecdd401311c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-28 02:21:18</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
